browser.adjustSearch: Adjust your search parameters or filters

search.title: Search Function
search.description:
Use the search bar to quickly find songs.

• Searches both song title and artist name
• Use romaji or Japanese kana to match readings
• Chinese simplified/traditional can match Japanese kanji (“东云” -> “東雲”)
• Normal characters can match special symbols (“embryO” -> “ΣmbryØ”)

Try typing your favorite song name!

filter.title: Filters
filter.description:
Click the filter button to open the advanced filter panel.

Toggle search fields (title, artist, reading, alias) at the top to control what gets matched.

You can filter songs by difficulty level, version, BPM, radar chart, and more.

You can also sort the results!

welcome.title: Welcome
welcome.description:
This is a chart browsing tool designed for Sound Voltex players.

Let's take a quick look at the main features!

musicGrid.title: Music List
musicGrid.description:
All songs matching your criteria are displayed as cards.

Click the artist name to quickly search for songs by the same artist.

Click a difficulty to view detailed information and chart view.

Scroll down to automatically load more songs.

discord.title: Join Discord
discord.description:
Click this button to join our Discord server.

You can report bugs, suggest features, and find more detailed tutorials!

finish.title: View Tutorial
finish.description: Click this button to view this tutorial again.

welcome.title: Chart View Page
welcome.description:
This is the detailed chart view and editing page.

Let's take a quick look at each feature area!

difficulty.title: Switch Charts
difficulty.description: Click the difficulty badges to switch between different charts.

sidebar.title: Info Panel
sidebar.description:
The info panel shows detailed song information. Click radar chart vertices to view specific values.

On mobile, open it via the info button in the top bar.

modeToggle.title: View / Edit Mode
modeToggle.description:
Switch between chart view and edit mode here.

After editing, switching back to view mode will render the edited chart in real time.

previewMode.title: View Mode
previewMode.description:
Choose an arrangement mode and adjust laser colors here.

In Random mode, you can click BT buttons to manually edit the order, swap FX or lasers.

editMode.title: Edit Mode
editMode.description:
• Speed Calculator: Enter your in-game Speed setting to view BPM / Hi-Speed multiplier / actual speed at different speed change points
• Simplify & Edit Lasers: Simplifies curved lasers and allows editing laser start/end points and inflection points in move mode
• HOLD Judgement Display: View every HOLD HEAD and SUSTAIN judgement point and window
• Interval Calculator: Select two objects in move mode to calculate interval time and beat notation

holdJudgement.title: HOLD Judgement Display
holdJudgement.description:
When enabled, displays the judgement points and windows used by the game for all HOLDs.

• Blue: HEAD start judgement, window from 133.333 ms early to 100 ms late
• Green: SUSTAIN continuous judgement points, window of ±16.667 ms. **Holding for 75% or more within this window (i.e., ≥25 ms out of 33.334 ms) counts as CRITICAL**

drawArea.title: View Controls
drawArea.description:
Adjust pixels per second, download chart image, adjust zoom, and enter fullscreen here.

In the chart viewing area, use scroll wheel for horizontal scrolling, Shift+wheel for vertical, Ctrl+wheel to zoom.

In pan mode, you can also drag to move the view.

moveMode.title: Move Mode
moveMode.description:
Drag objects; moved objects get a blue border.

Drag hold tails to change length, drag hold heads or chips vertically to reposition.

moveMode2.title: Move Mode (cont.)
moveMode2.description:
With "Simplify & Edit Lasers" on, freely drag laser start/end points and inflection points.

Drag range limits available below — when enabled, dragging is restricted to the allowed judgment range.

addMode.title: Add Mode
addMode.description:
Add BT, FX notes and speed marks.

When adding a speed mark, enter the target Hi-Speed and the duration for the speed change. It will affect the HS after the operation completes.

editPointerMode.title: Edit Mode
editPointerMode.description:
Click a hold head or chip to toggle between hold and chip.

Click a speed mark to edit its values.

resetSelected.title: Reset Selected
resetSelected.description: When an object is selected, click this button to restore it to its original state (position and hold length).

deleteSelected.title: Delete Selected
deleteSelected.description: When an object is selected, click this button to delete it. You can also press Delete or Backspace.

playMode.title: Play Mode
playMode.description:
Play mode scrolls the chart like in-game playback.

You can control playback, adjust speed, enable a metronome, and load BGM audio for synchronized playback.

playTransport.title: Transport Controls
playTransport.description:
Use these buttons to control playback:

• Rewind / Forward: jump 5 seconds
• Play / Pause: start or pause playback
• Stop: pause and return to the beginning

Drag the progress bar below to seek to any position.

playMetronome.title: Metronome
playMetronome.description:
Enable the metronome to hear beat cues during playback.

• Adjustable volume
• Beat subdivisions: 1/4, 1/8, 1/12, 1/16, 1/24, 1/32

playBgm.title: BGM Audio
playBgm.description:
Load the song's audio file for synchronized playback with the chart.

• Click the button to select a local audio file
• Adjustable volume
• Use Offset to fine-tune audio-chart synchronization

playKeyboard.title: Keyboard Shortcuts
playKeyboard.description:
Play mode supports these keyboard shortcuts:

• Space: Play / Pause
• Left Arrow: Seek back 2 seconds
• Right Arrow: Seek forward 2 seconds

chart.clickAnotherNote: Click another note to measure interval
